messages.content: Describe the color of the rooftop stranger's outfit.
Green.
What happened when the first man walked off the glass roof?
He walked on the air.
Why did the earth children go unnoticed as the balloon came down?
Same size as the Mangaboos.
Where did the kitten nap as the Mangaboos waited for the balloon?
On the buggy seat.
What does the Prince say his people have to do if they sprout?
They must be planted at once.
Where had every ruler of the Mangaboos grown?
The Royal Bush.
How was the clothing on a growing Mangaboo formed?
It grew on their bodies.
What image describes the twisting mass in the Garden of the Clinging Vines?
A nest of snakes.
What sound did the group hear as they followed the path toward the cottage?
A bird twittering.
Why did the Wizard think the Gargoyles left them alive in the tower?
For a ceremony.
What was Eureka's comparison for the mouths she saw in the dark cavern?
Coal-scuttles.
How far into the past did the dragonette say its pedigree extended?
About twenty thousand years.
What position was the Wizard offered when Ozma asked him to stay?
Official Wizard.
What did Jim choose to eat when the Lion asked about breakfast?
Clover.
How many lawyers did Oz have at the time of Eureka's trial?
None.
What did the man with braids insist that Dorothy accept for the ribbon?
A box of rustles.
